title: The Miremist
kicker: A mist-wrapped place where route certainty breaks down and the forest makes navigation feel like an audit of attention.
hook: A mist-wrapped place where route certainty breaks down and the forest makes navigation feel like an audit of attention.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The Miremist makes certainty expensive: fog, wet roots, and route sounds that arrive from the wrong distance.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: The fog has opinions about where you are going. Crooked posts mark a trail that is only a trail at the right water level. Luminous puddles double the lights and lie about distance. Cheerful little warning-charms dangle from the posts, and the soft ground...

blocks.label: What Is Here
blocks.body: Local residents or workers appropriate to the place Mist-Things move as half-seen animal shapes Eeligator wakes disturb deep pools Ward-Moths drift where old lines run under water No default combatant; add only if the scene introduces one Local civic, trade...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: Almost nothing safe to eat grows out here, but the mire hides rare herbs worth a fortune to anyone brave or foolish enough to fetch them. Foragers carry their own bread and trust nothing they did not pack themselves.

affordances: Look for the busiest local gathering point.
